text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Deyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa! Teyaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
(WOOOOAAAHH!)

In stark contrast to the friendly pre-race 
atmosphere, the Takarazuka Kinen turned 
into a literal fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... The post-race air is always so 
precious... But today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The purity... is different? This spiritual 
pressure feels several times stronger than 
usual...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* Well done on making it this 
far, Doto. All the way up to this canopy 
where I stand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This is our promised encounter. And our 
story begins right here!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no one ahead of you—except me! And 
there's no one ahead of me—except you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san! I'm truly, truly sorry for 
keeping you waiting soooo long!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, I've made it this far. Aiming for 
Opera O-san, stepping forward one by 
one...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become the person I've always 
looked up to! So, pleeease take good care 
of me from now on!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Please run with me again and again, over 
and overrrr!
(UOOOOOH!!)

The venue erupted into absolute 
pandemonium at the two declaring 
themselves rivals. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Is this... an Umamusume-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Or... is it because it's Opera O-san and 
Doto-san?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Inside my ears... it's so hot... Feels 
like something's about to pop out...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's because it's a fated showdown, right? 
There's definitely something special just 
between those two...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun, thank you for guest starring 
in our theater today. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"For you, the next race is the real deal, 
isn't it? Show me then—the dance of the 
Sand Princess."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Good luck. I'll be sure to learn a lot 
from your dirt race, Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Though I don't know if I can put on 
a race as precious as the two of them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Still, this live—I mean, race gave 
Digi-tan so much power!

And the road continues onward to the 
"Japan Dirt Derby." In pursuit of the 
reason behind the Umamusume's burning 
passion.
